LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldPairs.eq_def :: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (x : ℕ) (x_1 : List (Bool × ℕ)), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldPairs H x x_1 = match x, x_1 with | x, [] => [] | x, bs :: p => LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.stepPair x bs :: LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldPairs H (H (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.stepPair x bs).1 (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.stepPair x bs).2) p
LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldPairs_snoc :: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (p : List (Bool × ℕ)) (bs : Bool × ℕ) (x : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldPairs H x (p ++ [bs]) = LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldPairs H x p ++ [LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.stepPair (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.foldRoot H x p) bs]
LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.foldRoot_cons :: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (x : ℕ) (bs : Bool × ℕ) (p : List (Bool × ℕ)), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.foldRoot H x (bs :: p) = LeanShieldedPool.Refine.foldRoot H (H (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.stepPair x bs).1 (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.stepPair x bs).2) p

LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.fold_level_prefix :: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (I : List Bool) (P : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) (p : List (Bool × ℕ)), p.length ≤ d → (∀ (i : ℕ) (b : Bool) (s : ℕ), p[i]? = some (b, s) → I.getD i false = b ∧ P.getD i 0 = s) → List.foldl (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.level H d I P) x (List.range p.length) = LeanShieldedPool.Refine.foldRoot H x p

LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.pairs.eq_def :: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (x : ℕ) (x_1 : List ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.pairs H x x_1 = match x, x_1 with | 0, x => [] | l.succ, M => if M.length ≤ 2 ^ l then LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.pairs H l M else (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.sub H l (List.take (2 ^ l) M), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.sub H l (List.drop (2 ^ l) M)) :: (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.pairs H l (List.take (2 ^ l) M) ++ LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.pairs H l (List.drop (2 ^ l) M))
LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.pow_pos' :: ∀ (l : ℕ), 0 < 2 ^ l

LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.rootOf_eq_sub :: ∀ (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (L : List ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.rootOf H L = LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.sub H (LeanShieldedPool.Refine.imtOf H L).depth L
